ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible surface is approximately 97% low-intensity (black) with <3% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in small spots and linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black area across the entire visible surface; small, high-contrast white focal spots located in the mid-right lobe and upper-mid left lobe; dense white/grey clusters localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serration across the entire span; trailing edge boundary exhibits jagged pixel-level peaks and valleys spaced roughly 10-30 pixels apart.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast nodes (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips; isolated white circular pixels visible on the interior ventral surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple distinct white vertical and diagonal linear pixel paths (rake marks) concentrated on the upper-right lobe and scattered single linear marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins and trailing edges; visible linear rake-mark scarring on the right lobe surface.
